note: Canonical machine-readable routing table. CONTROL_RULES.md renders the same row IDs for people; change both together, bump policy_version and get independent review. Not active: no checker or host enforces it yet (G-02/G-03).
match_semantics: match_any: OR between clauses. Inside a clause: AND between fields; operations/write_zones/content_use: actual value is one of the list; conditions_all: every condition holds; conditions_any: at least one holds.

rows.title: Read/survey or create a new draft in working/new output; no original, register, permission, install/export or external write
rows.note: No Reviewer call and no separate task record required. A standing group grant covers it.

rows.title: Deterministic operation by a recipe accepted at this exact version, not changing a user decision
rows.note: No LLM review per file. Both conditions must hold. A tool name is not a recipe; a new or changed recipe, or an accepted recipe that changes a user decision, goes to R-MUTATION; an unknown decision effect goes to R-UNCLASSIFIED.

rows.title: New or off-recipe overwrite/delete of sources, register or provenance change
Verification status, schema/policy or permission change; skill install/export
rows.additional_owner: skills/README.md (intake standard for install/export; a Reviewer verdict does not replace it)
rows.note: Never a recipe. A review does not issue a grant; a grant change still needs the user or an issuer the user authorized.

rows.title: Content to sign, send outside or use as a decision basis; claim that a source/content is verified
rows.note: Adds to any mutation row that also matches; content_use can only add requirements, its absence is not evidence of low risk.

rows.title: Send data out, network write, hard-to-reverse effect or envelope overrun
rows.note: A grant still in force is reused; review neither replaces consent nor raises limits.

rows.title: Call Scout/Worker/Reviewer within the granted role, tools, scope and limits
rows.note: Needs a full delegation descriptor (callee role, parent/child task, tool scope, requested envelope) inside the grant's delegate_callees and the parent task; a trusted grant alone is not enough. Calling a Reviewer is not itself reviewed (no recursion). Effects performed by the delegate follow their own rows.

rows.title: Unclassifiable operation, or missing recipe/authority/required review
rows.note: Also the route for any effect no other row matches and for any condition the checker cannot resolve. Blocks the dependent effect; independent read/draft work may continue. Never falls back to R-READ_DRAFT.

rows.title: Format or structure known to be lost by the operation
rows.note: Refuse before the transaction; a warning after writing is not enough. A safe refusal does not prove support for that format.
